tools.name: find_orders
tools.description: Lists the signed-in customer's AIDevMe orders, newest first. Use it when the customer doesn't know the order number.

status.description: Order status filter: Any, Open, Shipped, Delivered or Cancelled. Default Any.

from.description: Earliest order date as an ISO 8601 date, for example 2026-10-01. Leave empty for no lower limit.

to.description: Latest order date as an ISO 8601 date. Leave empty for no upper limit.

tools.name: get_order_status
tools.description: Returns the status of one AIDevMe order by its number (for example SO-10023): order lines, carrier, tracking number and expected delivery date.

tools.name: create_return
tools.description: Starts a return for one line of a delivered AIDevMe order and returns the return number (RMA). Confirm the item, quantity and reason with the customer before calling it.

lineNumber.description: Order line to return, as shown by get_order_status, for example 1.

quantity.description: Number of items to return from that line, at least 1.

reason.description: Return reason: Damaged, WrongItem, NotAsDescribed or NoLongerNeeded.

comment.description: Optional details from the customer, for example what is damaged.
